segments.ja340:1.1: Adāsi dānāni pure visayha, dadato ca te khayadhammo ahosi;
segments.ja340:1.3: Ito paraṃ ce na dadeyya dānaṃ, tiṭṭheyyuṃ te saṃyamantassa bhogā.
segments.ja340:2.3: Mā vo dhanaṃ taṃ ahu devarāja [ahuvā janinda (ka. sī. syā. pī.)], yaṃ bhogahetu vijahemu saddhaṃ.
segments.ja340:3.1: Yena eko ratho yāti, yāti tenāparo ratho;
segments.ja340:3.3: Porāṇaṃ nihitaṃ vattaṃ, vattataññeva [vaddhaṃ, vaddhataññeva (ka. sī. pī.)] vāsava.
segments.ja340:4.1: Yadi hessati dassāma, asante kiṃ dadāmase;
segments.ja340:7.3: Atha jambu tiṇāsanapīṭhavaraṃ, atha taṇḍula mora visayha dasāti.

lines: Idaṃ vuttaṃ hoti – yena maggena eko ratho yāti, aññopi ratho “rathassa gatamaggo eso”ti teneva maggena yāti.
Porāṇaṃ nihitaṃ vattanti yaṃ mayā pubbe nihitaṃ vattaṃ, taṃ mayi dharante vattatuyeva, mā tiṭṭhatūti attho.
Evaṃbhūtāti evaṃ tiṇahārakabhūtāpi mayaṃ yāva jīvāma, tāva dassāmayeva.
Adadanto hi dānaṃ pamajjati nāma na sarati na sallakkheti, ahaṃ pana jīvamāno dānaṃ pamussituṃ na icchāmi, tasmā dānaṃ dassāmiyevāti dīpeti.
